description: MainActivity class implementation for an Android app, managing bottom navigation, a floating action button for scanning, and fragment management.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main entry point of the app that manages bottom navigation, a floating action button for initiating scans, and fragment switching.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up layout, configures bottom navigation and floating scan button, and loads default fragment.

methods.name: setupBottomNav
methods.description: Configures bottom navigation item selection to switch between documents and account fragments.

methods.name: openFragment
methods.description: Replaces current fragment with the specified fragment in the container.
